description: Regression: a clip whose media file fails to open must NOT hold the seek-sync gate. The fixture's only clip points at a missing file, so its media never opens (loaded=false, no FrameBuffer), but its serialized AudioSource is still emplaced. Before the fix, the gate's videoReady/audioReady predicates waited on that clip for the full 3s preroll failsafe, freezing the playhead (Timeline advances only when Playing && !gated). After the fix the predicates skip unserviceable clips, the gate releases immediately, and the playhead advances. We assert the playhead moved ~1s worth of frames after a 1s wall-clock play; a stuck-at-0 playhead (gate held) fails the assert. Wait stays well under the 3s failsafe so a held gate can't be masked by the timeout firing.
